en: Fixed voice dictation not stopping on Ctrl+C (the prompt cleared but the microphone kept recording), Esc not cancelling while a transcript was processing, and held Space starting dictation from the transcript view and vim NORMAL mode
zh: 修复语音听写无法通过 Ctrl+C 停止（prompt 已清空但麦克风仍在录音）、转写处理期间 Esc 无法取消，以及长按空格会从转写视图和 vim NORMAL 模式启动听写的问题
